angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 33,254,460 km at 39620.70 pc = 0.01 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 12452: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 39620.7 +/- 3968.2 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 39620.7 +/- 3968.2 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.0091 +/- 0.0164 mas (same row, RUWE 1.12), 0.6 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 47.8 +/- 4.8 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 12452: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 47.8 +/- 4.8 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 33,254,460 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5750 +/- 125 K from Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=LMC0107, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5750 +/- 125 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=LMC0107, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5750 +/- 125 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 1.78 from 2022AJ....163..152S (APOGEE Net, a survey pipeline: no analysis of this star's own spectra is published); the 1 published value span log g 1.78 to 1.78, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.0% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..152S)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, SV* HV 12452: projected rotation speed 11.75 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2020AJ....160..120J)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
